failure_summary: The assembled prompt states 'Better move: column 5 (lands at c5r6)' verbatim, yet runs 0-2 name no column at all ('the column that keeps your threat alive') and runs 3-4 name the square only in raw cNrM notation, so no run gives the blunderer a plain-English column to play; production-fidelity model (gpt-5.4-mini) means prompt_confusion here cannot be separated from model capability, and the three A6 failures are partly an OI-183 eval artifact because mentionsBetterColumn is production's own retry trigger.
notes: A6 (runs 0,1,2, copied from mechanical): prose never names column 5 although PROMPT contains 'Better move: column 5 (lands at c5r6)'; production would have retried these (OI-183), so treat as eval artifact.
